decisions.proposed_text: Không có Uma khác để xem
decisions.reason: Compact 'Uma' and removal of the unnecessary classifier preserve the no-other-character-to-view state with less width.

decisions.proposed_text: Hiển thị đổi trạng thái khi đua
decisions.reason: The compact wording preserves showing state changes during the race while removing the wide literal construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Kích hoạt do kỹ năng gọi
decisions.reason: This is a technical activation-reason label; the shorter wording retains that the effect was triggered through another skill calling it.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có kỹ năng phù hợp
decisions.reason: The condition context is already established by the filtered skill list, so 'điều kiện' is redundant and can be removed safely.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có lịch sử kích hoạt kỹ năng
decisions.reason: The current viewer already implies that records are being viewed; the compact phrase keeps the activated-skill history meaning.

decisions.proposed_text: Chưa là đối tượng hướng dẫn
decisions.reason: The status does not need the verbose 'đặt làm' construction; the guide-target state remains explicit.

decisions.proposed_text: Sự kiện đua đang xem đã kết thúc
decisions.reason: Replacing the verbose 'đang hiển thị' with 'đang xem' keeps the currently displayed race-event meaning and improves fit.

decisions.proposed_text:
Sự kiện đã kết thúc
Đã bỏ đối tượng hướng dẫn
decisions.reason: The two-line result can state the cause and automatic target removal directly; the source newline count is preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Hiện cửa sổ Hướng dẫn Trainer
decisions.reason: Using the compact display verb reduces width while preserving that the Trainer Guide popup/window is shown.

decisions.proposed_text: Kiểm tra thích nghi Hướng dẫn Trainer
decisions.reason: The noun phrase 'độ thích nghi của' can be compressed without changing that this screen checks Trainer Guide suitability.

decisions.proposed_text: Xác nhận dùng Hướng dẫn Trainer
decisions.reason: The shorter verb preserves the confirmation to use the Trainer Guide while improving fixed-title fit.

decisions.proposed_text: Hướng dẫn Trainer đã cập nhật
decisions.reason: The current guide is already the displayed object, so 'đang hiển thị' and the passive helper can be removed without changing the update result.

decisions.proposed_text: Sự kiện đua đang xem đã kết thúc
decisions.reason: This duplicate status can use the same compact wording as the equivalent displayed-race-event end notice for consistency.

decisions.proposed_text: Bỏ đối tượng hướng dẫn
decisions.reason: The existing setting context already identifies the selected target, so 'đã thiết lập' is redundant in the removal action.

decisions.proposed_text: Hủy đối tượng hướng dẫn
decisions.reason: The action can omit the abstract 'thiết lập' noun while preserving that the guide-target assignment is canceled.

decisions.proposed_text: Cập nhật Hướng dẫn Trainer
decisions.reason: The displayed guide is implicit in the current screen, so the compact action label keeps the update function without redundant context.

decisions.proposed_text: Chọn <color=#ff911c>cốt truyện Hướng dẫn đề xuất</color>
decisions.reason: The compact wording keeps the Trainer Guide recommendation relationship while removing the wide trailing phrase; the color markup is preserved exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Mở khóa khi CLASS cao nhất đạt {0}
decisions.reason: The direct unlock-condition form is shorter while preserving the exact CLASS threshold placeholder.

decisions.proposed_text: Cập nhật cuộc đua sau <color=#ff911c>{0}</color>
decisions.reason: The countdown reads more compactly as an update-after duration; the color markup and placeholder are preserved exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Chưa đủ điều kiện tham gia
decisions.reason: The natural compact form preserves that participation requirements are not yet met and removes the wider formal phrasing.
